messages.body_plain:
Hi everyone,

just a quick reminder of the Bioc teaching call on Monday, December 7 at 2pm CET. The jitsi link, as usual, is https://meet.jit.si/BioconductorTeaching.
The agenda is available in the Google Doc - the main topic will be exercise design, which Toby will kindly guide us through.
Last time we converged towards using the data set proposed by Kevin (from https://www.nature.com/articles/s41467-018-07329-0) for the intro module. Kevin has prepared a repository with information on how to pull down the data here: https://github.com/kevinrue/bioc-teaching-intro. Running dev/geo-download.sh followed by dev/make-se.R should generate the SummarizedExperiment object (I just tried and it worked fine).

See you on Monday,
Charlotte & Laurent
